title: Incident reconstruction
description: One incident's timeline on the clock the pack interval chooses: the incident, the other records of it, events, interventions and diagnostics involving its machines, at its site or in its zone, and the statements of the documents that report it, each citing its evidence (Memory ADR 0013). A machine is followed to every other id Memory states is the same machine (same_as, stated or observed, never inferred or a candidate), and the same_as claims that link them are cited (Deploy ADR 0019); a machine no same_as links is shown as not linked, and nothing is read from another id that merely looks alike. An entry on another clock is placed only through a clock mapping Memory states, and names it; with none it is listed as not placed, never guessed. Records of one event that state different times are a conflict: every time is shown with its difference, none is chosen. Co-occurrence is listed apart and is never cause.

sections.title: Records of this incident
sections.description: Which other records Memory states are the same incident (same_as, followed through every stated or observed link, never inferred), and which it cannot decide (same_as_candidate: every reading, none chosen).

sections.title: Reconstruction on the chosen clock
sections.description: Each placement on the pack clock in onset order: the event's stated kind, severity, description, machines, place and the record it rests on. A placement through a clock mapping names the mapping records. Records of one event are compared as one event. Events involving any id of an involved machine (through same_as) are included.

sections.title: Identities of the machines involved
sections.description: Every other id Memory states names the same machine as one the incident involves (same_as: stated or observed, never inferred; each claim cites the records that declare the ids together), and every reading it cannot decide (same_as_candidate, never followed). The sections below read each involved machine under these ids only. NOT COVERED here means the machine is not linked: no other id is read for it, and an id that merely looks alike is never taken as the same machine.

sections.title: Configuration of the machines involved
sections.description: The configuration chain of each machine the incident involves: decided, ambiguous or unknown spans, on their own clocks. Each machine is read under every id same_as links to it.

sections.title: Configuration changes
sections.description: Each change of configuration of a machine the incident involves, attributed to that machine only: a decided span ending at the instant a decided span of another configuration begins, on one clock (graph-schema 2 rule 12). A boundary that an ambiguous, inferred or unknown span meets is shown as such, every reading with it: no change is read across it, and where two decided spans also meet there their change stands beside it. A change is the machine's own: configuration nodes are shared by every machine naming them, so nothing here is read from succeeds or from another machine. Each id is read on its own spans.

sections.title: Runs of the machines involved
sections.description: The runs the involved machines recorded, with the configuration bound to each, on the run's own clock. Runs recorded under any id same_as links to the machine are included.

sections.title: Clocks and mappings
sections.description: The clocks the involved machines record on, and every mapping Memory states from them (its parameters as stated, never applied here). A clock no mapping relates to the pack clock is why an entry is not placed. Clocks of any id same_as links to the machine are included.

sections.title: Co-occurrence (never cause)
sections.description: Pairs of events from different sources whose onsets fall within the configured window on one clock. Co-occurrence is not causation.
